title: Consultor(a) SAP ECP Pleno/Senior
description:
Hr Path Group

O Grupo HR Path, um interveniente global na consultoria de RH, acompanha os seus clientes nos seus projetos de transformação de RH, tanto nos aspectos humanos como nas ferramentas (HRIS). Intervimos na Europa, América e Ásia-Pacífico, para as nossas grandes contas e clientes PME, a fim de lhes oferecer um apoio global no desenvolvimento da sua estratégia de RH.

Aconselhar para executar! HR Path, líder mundial em soluções de RH

  • Advise: Acompanhamos os nossos clientes na transformação da sua função de RH, através de uma redefinição da sua organização de RH e da digitalização do seu HRIS
  • Implement: Como parceiro dos principais editores do mercado, realizamos projetos de implementação técnica e funcional de todas as soluções HRIS (SaaS ou On-Premise)
  • Run: Graças à nossa experiência global em processamento de salários, oferecemos aos nossos clientes vários níveis de externalização de salários.


O que estamos buscando:

Profissional fará parte do time de consultores funcionais de projetos do Sistema SAP ECP para Folha de Pagamento. Deverá executar atividades conforme melhores práticas de mercado seguindo nossa metodologia de implementação.


Atividades a serem desenvolvidas:

Atuar em projetos de implementação do ECP com foco em Folha de Pagamento;

Elaborar documentações necessárias de cada atividade de acordo com padrão estabelecido por cada cliente;

Ministrar treinamento para usuários;

Treinar e capacitar pessoas da equipe/clientes nos módulos do SAP ECP;

Colaborar com equipes internas e fornecedores para implementar as soluções propostas;

Manter-se atualizado com as últimas liberações e produtos da SAP que envolvem os módulos do SAP /ECP.


Requisitos:

  • Formação superior em Administração, RH, Sistemas ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência de no mínimo 12 anos nos módulos do SAP HCM/ECP com atuação em projetos;
  • Atuação como consultor responsável/líder da frente em pelo menos 1 projeto de medio a grande porte;
  • Conhecimento em eSocial, desejável;
  • Certificação SAP nos módulos relevantes, caso não tenha será necessário se certificar para iniciar nos projetos;
  • Conhecimento Funcional na Integração entre os sistemas EC x ECP e/ou EC x HCM;
  • Conhecimento em Folha de Pagamentos de outros países será um diferencial.


O que oferecemos:

  • Um ambiente de trabalho estimulante no seio de uma cultura empreendedora e internacional
  • Uma abordagem transversal das nossas atividades, que favorece o trabalho em equipe e a excelência
  • Numerosas oportunidades de progressão (mobilidade horizontal, vertical e internacional)
  • Múltiplas oportunidades de formação (universidade interna, certificações)
  • Certificado Happy at Work, oferecemos um bom equilíbrio de vida com possibilidades de teletrabalho
  • Um ambiente de trabalho amigável (atividades de equipe trimestrais, seminário internacional anual)


Nos vemos em breve na HR Path!

title: Analista de dados sênior
description:
Analista de Dados SR


Modalidade : Remoto


Estamos em busca de um Analista de Dados talentoso e motivado para se juntar à nossa equipe. O candidato ideal terá experiência em análise de dados, desenvolvimento de processos ETL e habilidades sólidas em programação com Python, além de conhecimento em SQL e serviços da AWS. O Analista de Dados será responsável por transformar dados brutos em informações valiosas para tomada de decisões estratégicas.


Responsabilidades :

- Extrair, transformar e carregar (ETL) dados de diversas fontes, garantindo a qualidade e integridade das informações.

- Desenvolver e otimizar scripts em Python para automação de processos e análise de dados.

- Criar e manter consultas SQL para manipulação e extração de dados de bancos relacionais.

- Trabalhar com ferramentas e serviços da AWS para armazenamento, processamento e análise de dados (ex.: Amazon S3, Redshift, Athena).

- Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para entender requisitos de negócios e traduzir em soluções analíticas.

- Produzir relatórios e dashboards que ajudem na visualização e interpretação dos dados.

- Monitorar e melhorar continuamente os processos de dados, propondo soluções inovadoras.


Requisitos :

- Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas relacionadas.

- Experiência comprovada em programação Python para análise de dados.

- Sólidos conhecimentos em SQL e experiência com bancos de dados relacionais.

- Experiência em processos de ETL e ferramentas relacionadas.

- Familiaridade com serviços da AWS, especialmente em soluções de armazenamento e processamento de dados.

- Habilidade em comunicação e trabalho em equipe.

- Capacidade de resolver problemas de forma criativa e analítica.


Diferenciais :

- Conhecimento em ferramentas de visualização de dados (ex.: Tableau, Power BI).

- Experiência com Big Data e tecnologias como Hadoop ou Spark.

- Certificações relevantes na área de análise de dados ou AWS.

title: Data Annotator
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.


Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.


We’re excited to share that Innodata Inc. is expanding its AI and Machine Learning Talent Network , and we’re looking for passionate, detail-oriented professionals to join us as Data Annotators and Content Moderators (Review & Labeling) .

If you enjoy working with data, have a strong eye for detail, and wish to contribute to real-world AI innovation , this is a wonderful opportunity to become part of a forward-thinking global team .


Location: Brazil, Language: Portuguese


Key Responsibilities

  • Review, label, and moderate online content (may include sensitive material).
  • Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and overall quality.
  • Contribute to building AI training datasets for next-generation systems.
  • Provide feedback and insights to enhance ongoing processes.


Requirements

  • Minimum qualification: High School completed or pursuing Bachelors.
  • Strong command of English (written and verbal) .
  • Excellent analytical and communication skills .
  • Comfortable working with diverse content types.
  • Access to a private, secure workspace with stable internet .


If you’re detail-oriented, tech-curious , and eager to contribute to the future of AI , we’d love to have you in our growing network.


If Interested, kindly send your resume at: .

title: Gerente de projeto de design
description:
Sobre a vaga

A Bas-Alto é um estúdio de design full-service que opera sob o modelo de fractional design team: o fundador atua como design lead embedded em empresas parceiras, integrado aos times e às decisões de produto e de marca. A Bas-Alto é a estrutura que sustenta essa atuação: um time de designers entregando produto, web e visual design em paralelo, com o Gerente de Projetos/DesignOps garantindo que tudo opere com consistência enquanto o fundador está focado na frente estratégica. Site para referência:


Estamos contratando um(a) Gerente de Projetos de Design para trabalhar como \"braço direito operacional \" do fundador do estúdio na gestão de projetos de design. O papel central é garantir que o time de designers tenha sempre briefings claros, prioridades bem definidas e entregas organizadas, mantendo múltiplos projetos simultâneos rodando com qualidade e sem perder prazo.


Responsabilidades

  • Relacionamento com os clientes no dia a dia , respondendo a dúvidas, alinhando expectativas e garantindo que estejam sempre informados sobre o andamento dos projetos (por escrito, em inglês).
  • Suporte direto ao design lead na condução dos projetos e organização de demandas
  • Criação de briefings executáveis que traduzem as necessidades e objetivos em projetos para a equipe de design
  • Gerenciar tarefas , entregas e prazos em plataformas como ClickUp, Asana, Notion ou similares
  • Acompanhar o andamento de entregas de design (produto, web e marketing), garantindo qualidade e consistência
  • Fazer o handoff das entregas finais para os clientes, garantindo clareza, organização e um padrão elevado de apresentação
  • Estruturar fluxos de trabalho, cronogramas e processos internos
  • Antecipar gargalos, resolver impedimentos e manter os projetos em movimento

Diferencial: D ireção de design dos projetos (para candidatos com background sólido em design)


Necessário

  • Experiência sólida em gestão de projetos , de preferência em estúdios de design, agências ou startups
  • Experiência sólida no setor de tecnologia e de gestão de produtos digitais
  • Familiaridade com Figma e com o universo de design: entender o que são um wireframe, um design system, uma entrega de UI ou um fluxo de UX.
  • Inglês fluente em escrita e leitura.
  • Extrema organização e atenção a detalhe para manejar múltiplas frentes ao mesmo tempo
  • Comunicação clara e objetiva, tanto com clientes quanto com a equipe
  • Domínio de ferramentas de gestão de projetos (ClickUp, Asana, Notion, Jira ou similares)
  • Experiência com um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico/ágil de startups


Remuneração e modelo

  • Salário a partir de R$ 3.600+, podendo ser significativamente maior para candidatos com background sólido em design (que consigam atuar também na direção de design dos projetos).
  • Contratação: CLT ou PJ, a negociar
  • Formato de trabalho: 100% remoto
  • Horário flexível. Obs.: É necessária disponibilidade para atender demandas também no período noturno, devido ao fuso horário dos clientes da Califórnia (4h antes do horário do Brasil).

  • Build and maintain real-time data pipelines for inventory, pricing, orders, and customer activity
  • Implement event-driven systems using Kafka
  • Develop and optimize search and catalog capabilities using Elasticsearch

title: Executive Administrative Assistant
description:
Instead of applying to one remote job, you could access a community where new remote opportunities become available every week.


At Virtual Latinos, we connect experienced professionals from Latin America with growing companies in the U.S., Canada, and beyond that are building distributed remote teams. Our community includes more than 5,000+ professionals hired and 2,500+ companies that rely on Virtual Latinos to find skilled remote talent.


Join a community where you'll learn, connect with like-minded professionals, and access real remote opportunities with top North American companies.


Highlight Role of the Week!


Executive Administrative Assistant (Remote)


About the role:


This opportunity is designed for experienced administrative professionals who are comfortable supporting leadership teams, coordinating business priorities, and ensuring operations run smoothly in fast-paced remote environments.


Pay Rates:


Part-time Monthly Rates: $800 to $1,280 (20 hours per week)


Full-time Monthly Rates: $1,600 to $2,560 (40 hours per week)


The posted monthly salary range is an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated based on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $10- $16, depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.


Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the position and client. Most schedules align with U.S. and Canadian business hours.


Key responsibilities:


  • Executive Calendar Management: Coordinate complex scheduling across multiple time zones and manage executive priorities.
  • Inbox & Communications: Oversee executive inbox communication, draft professional responses, and manage internal/external correspondence on behalf of leadership.
  • Project Coordination: Coordinate projects across teams while ensuring deadlines and milestones remain aligned.
  • Reporting: Prepare executive summaries, presentations, and operational reports.
  • CRM & Systems: Support CRM management and maintain accurate operational records across platforms.
  • Stakeholder Liaison: Act as a point of contact between executives, internal teams, clients, and vendors.
  • Process Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve administrative workflows and operational efficiency.


What you bring:


  • Must be 21+ years old
  • 3+ years of experience in administrative support, executive assistance, or operations coordination roles
  • Bilingual English (C1 or above) /Spanish
  • Experience supporting executives, founders, or leadership teams


Required:


  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities independently in remote environments
  • Proficient in Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Docs, Sheets, Drive) and/or Microsoft Office 365
  • Working knowledge of CRM platforms (HubSpot, Salesforce) and project management tools (Asana, ClickUp, Monday or similar)
  • Comfortable with Slack, Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Calendly, Canva, and AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude)


How the process works


  • Apply through LinkedIn Easy Apply.
  • Qualified candidates will receive instructions to complete their full application and join the Virtual Latinos community.
  • Once accepted, you will gain access to ongoing remote job opportunities with U.S. companies looking for experienced remote professionals.

title: Senior AI Engineer (Python)
description:
We are seeking a full-time, remote Senior AI Engineer with 5+ years of software development experience and a strong background building AI native software to join our U.S. client. You will provide leadership and expertise to advance strategic and technical goals of our client.

Our client is a venture studio that surrounds industry subject matter experts with senior technical talent to build AI-native software solving real-world problems as well as consulting services to propel software companies along their AI journey.


Responsibilities

  • Provide strategic and technical expertise to AI-powered, engineering initiatives
  • Advise startups on AI product development using agentic AI, LLMs, and modern AI infrastructure
  • Develop software in conjunction with startup subject matter experts and engineering teams
  • Stay abreast of AI trends and advise colleagues and clients on emerging AI opportunities
  • Communicate across different stakeholder groups including executive, boards, technical, client and industry


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and teamwork skills
  • 5+ years of software development experience including AI engineering
  • Strong proficiency in Python
  • Deep experience in AI product development using agents, LLMs, and modern AI infrastructure
  • Expertise with ML/LLM frameworks, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, or equivalent
  • Experience with vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and modern MLOps practices
  • Track record of deploying AI services in production
  • Strong grounding in cloud-native architectures (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Proven ability to stay self-motivated, work hard, own problems from start to finish, and deliver in a vibrant, fast-moving environment
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently or as part of a broader team.
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • University degree in a technical field
  • Experience with AWS


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and your national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (C#/.NET)
description:
We're looking for full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Software Engineers with 7+ years of experience delivering production-ready software. The ideal candidates will have recent hands-on C# /.NET, modern JS framework (Vue.js, React.js, Angular), and extensive end-to-end API and integration experience. You should thrive in fast-moving environments and be able to quickly translate ambiguous goals into working features, rapidly master new tools, and own your code from design through post-release support.


You'll collaborate with Senior and Staff engineers across North and South America, owning features from concept through production support and seeing users benefit almost immediately. If delivering practical solutions quickly and refining them in live environments motivates you, you'll fit right in.


Founded in 2003, our client transforms the traditional restaurant point-of-sale (POS) terminal into an integrated 360-degree operational management system. Their solution increases brand loyalty through improved customer experiences, optimizes operations resulting in lower costs, and increases sales volumes through comprehensive analytics and employee performance insights. Over 7,000 restaurant locations use their technology today, and they process over $5 Billion of payments annually.


Responsibilities:


  • Perform full life-cycle commercial software development and maintenance, including analyzing specifications, documenting requirements, and architecting, designing, developing, and maintaining software solutions
  • Collaborate with teams to design, develop, and produce high-quality code following best practices and standards for both new features and existing application maintenance
  • Own features end-to-end - UI through API and Data layer too
  • Support and refactor legacy code using modern methodologies and technologies
  • Analyze code to identify defect root causes and provide resolutions
  • Participate in daily standups and weekly team meetings to review priorities, progress, new ideas, and technologies
  • Address defects identified during various testing cycles
  • Perform high-quality peer reviews


Required Experience


  • Excellent written and spoken English; must be able to discuss trade-offs with teammates and stakeholders
  • 7+ years professional C#/.NET (Core and Framework) experience - recent in the last 2 years
  • Modern JavaScript framework experience (Vue.js, React.js, or Angular) - delivering new features, not just fixing bugs
  • Comfortable working end-to-end (UI, API, data layer, infra scripts); whatever it takes
  • Must have \"ownership mindset\" - you'll have the responsibility of designing, building, shipping, monitoring, and fixing the features you touch
  • Fluent in Git and modern branching / PR workflows

  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements
  • Net-worth monitoring;
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.
  • Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.


Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English .
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
  • not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

title: Professor de francês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!

Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?



  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Lead Generation Specialist
description:
The pay for this role will be between USD 693 to 850/month, depending on experience.


About Us

Publicity For Good (PFG) is a US-based, female-founded public relations agency that partners with impact-driven, heart-centered leaders and purpose-driven CPG brands (Food & Beverage, Fashion, and Beauty). We are an all-female team dedicated to amplifying brands that make a difference through meaningful visibility and measurable growth. We operate in a fun, fast-paced environment where collaboration creates magic.


Role

This position is responsible for generating and nurturing qualified leads with the primary objective of booking sales calls. The Lead Generation Specialist will manage inbound and outbound lead channels, validate prospect interest, coordinate with the sales team, and maintain an organized pipeline across multiple platforms.


As a Lead Generation Specialist , you will monitor and respond to leads from various sources including Meta ads, Leadhype, Smartlead, and GoHighLevel (GHL). You will conduct call show audits, manage follow-up sequences, update pipeline statuses, and ensure seamless handoff of qualified prospects to the sales team. This role requires strong communication skills, exceptional organization, and the ability to work independently across multiple systems while maintaining high response rates and booking quality.


Responsibilities

  • Monitor and respond to new leads across all platforms (GHL, Leadhype, Smartlead, Meta ads).
  • Conduct daily call show audits and update show/no-show statuses in tracking systems.
  • Manage and update the Airtable Lead Gen dashboard with accurate lead data and metrics.
  • Qualify inbound leads and schedule sales calls with interested prospects.
  • Execute manual follow-ups for warm leads and re-engagement campaigns.
  • Review and respond to positive replies from Leadhype and Smartlead outreach campaigns.
  • Update lead tags, statuses, and ownership in GHL based on prospect engagement and stage.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline management and ensure all conversations are properly categorized.
  • Coordinate reschedules for no-show prospects and maintain consistent follow-up cadence.
  • Process and segment new Meta ads leads into appropriate workflows.
  • Review notes from sales reps in GHL and take necessary follow-up actions.
  • Update sales team on lead status changes, show/no-show patterns, and booking confirmations.
  • Track daily lead generation metrics including new conversations, responses, and bookings.
  • Identify and flag low-quality leads or technical issues with lead sources.
  • Maintain organized conversation threads and ensure timely responses to all inquiries.
  • Collaborate with Sales and Marketing teams to improve lead quality and conversion rates.
  • Test and optimize messaging templates across platforms to improve response rates.
  • Ensure all lead generation software and integrations function properly.


Results

  • Consistently meet or exceed monthly sales call booking targets.
  • Maintain high response rates across all lead channels (within 1-2 hours for new leads).
  • Deliver accurate and timely daily reports on lead generation activities and pipeline status.
  • Ensure qualified leads are properly nurtured and handed off to sales with complete context.
  • Identify trends in lead quality, response rates, and show/no-show patterns.
  • Maintain an organized and up-to-date pipeline with proper tagging and segmentation.
  • Support predictable sales pipeline through consistent lead flow and booking quality.
  • Reduce lead leakage by ensuring no prospect falls through the cracks.
  • Contribute to improved conversion rates through effective qualification and pre-call preparation.


Requirements

  • Prior experience in lead generation, sales development, or appointment setting of at least 2 years.
  • Strong written communication skills with ability to engage prospects effectively.
  • Experience with CRM platforms, especially GoHighLevel (GHL), or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with lead generation platforms such as Leadhype, Smartlead, or comparable systems.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple lead sources and prioritize high-value opportunities.
  • Highly organized with excellent attention to detail and time management skills.
  • Self-motivated and able to work independently with minimal supervision.

title: Analista de processos
description:
Descrição da Empresa A nexo soluções tecnológicas é dedicada a oferecer soluções inovadoras que otimizam processos empresariais e aceleram a transformação digital. Nosso objetivo é ajudar empresas a melhorar a eficiência operacional e alcançar resultados estratégicos através da adoção de tecnologias avançadas. Com uma equipe de especialistas altamente qualificados, proporcionamos suporte personalizado e criativo. Valorizamos a inovação, colaboração e excelência em todas as etapas do trabalho.
Descrição do Cargo Procuramos um/a Analista de Processos para identificar, analisar e propor melhorias nos processos de negócios a fim de aumentar a eficiência organizacional. Suas responsabilidades incluem mapear processos, identificar gargalos, propor soluções e garantir sua implementação. Você também colaborará com diferentes equipes para entender as necessidades do negócio e transformar essas informações em ações estratégicas. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e será realizado de forma remota.
Qualificações
  • Gestão de Processos: Experiência em gestão e melhoria de processos empresariais, incluindo análise e mapeamento de fluxos de trabalho.
  • Análises e Tomada de Decisões: Habilidades analíticas para identificar pontos de aperfeiçoamento e propor soluções efetivas e inovadoras.
  • Comunicação e Colaboração: Capacidade de transmitir ideias de maneira clara e eficaz, e de colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para atingir objetivos comuns.
  • Formação em administração, engenharia de produção, tecnologia da informação ou áreas afins será considerada um diferencial, assim como experiência prévia com metodologias ágeis e ferramentas de mapeamento de processos.

title: Process Data & Integration Specialist - Remote Work
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role


The Accounting Analyst position serves as the key internal contact for the company's financial information, with full visibility of transactions and responsibility for the source data used in decision-making. This role involves participating in regular monthly closing cycles and contributing to the development of the accounting work frame. You'll understand the financial data management model and use appropriate data retrieval tools to prepare and process accounting information in a highly versatile team that constantly adapts to changing business needs.


Key responsibilities


- Reconciling accounts.

- Verifying cost center allocation and other inputs of accounting transactions.

- Compiling financial statements.

- Registering accruals and applying corrections in the accounting system.

- Generating reports and supporting decision-making processes.


Requirements


- Accounting Experience: Experience in accounting, accounts payable, bookkeeping, or accounts receivable.

- Excel Proficiency: Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables and Vlookup.

- ERP Systems: Experience with ERP management systems such as QuickBooks, Xero, SAP, or NetSuite.

- Language Proficiency: Advanced level of English.



Benefits:

- Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

- Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

- Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

- Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

- Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

- Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

- Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

- Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Almoxarife I
description:
Você está em uma jornada para ingressar em uma empresa emocionante e fazer parte de nossa história de sucesso. Aqui vamos equipá-lo com o know-how e a experiência que definirão seu crescimento. Nesta função em que você está prestes a embarcar, você deve cumprir as seguintes responsabilidades:

  • Atender às reservas e requisições de materiais, separando e entregando conforme necessidade das áreas internas.
  • Receber materiais conferindo AR (Autorização de Recebimento) e condições físicas dos produtos.
  • Armazenar os materiais em locais apropriados, respeitando critérios de segurança, validade e acessibilidade.
  • Realizar contagens cíclicas e apoiar na execução de inventários físicos.
  • Controlar prazos de validade e integridade dos materiais durante o armazenamento.
  • Apoiar na organização e limpeza do almoxarifado, conforme padrões de 5S.
  • Lançar movimentações básicas no sistema ERP, com apoio ou sob orientação do Almoxarife II ou do líder.
  • Comunicar divergências ou anomalias nos materiais ou processos ao superior imediato.
  • Apoiar em outras atividades do setor sempre que necessário.
  • Realizar descargas, e movimentações dentro do almoxarifado com o uso de empilhadeira.
  • Realizar outras atividades correlatas às descritas acima, compatível com a sua condição pessoal e conforme solicitado pelo seu superior imediato.


Requisitos:

  • Ensino médio Completo.
  • Habilitação em Empilhadeira (NR 11).
  • Carteira de Habilitação B.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação 100% presencial em Feira de Santana - BA.
  • Experiência atuando em almoxarifado.
  • Vivência no pacote office, principalmente Excel;
  • Conhecimento em procedimentos de recebimento, conferência e controle de estoque, em sistema ERP (movimentações, baixas, requisições) e em inventário físico e contagem cíclica.


Aviso Legal:

Ao nos enviar seu currículo e dados pessoais, considera-se que você deu seu consentimento para que mantenhamos suas informações em nosso banco de dados de recrutamento de talentos. Todas as informações fornecidas serão usadas exclusivamente para o processo seletivo. A RGE somente coletará, utilizará, processará ou divulgará informações pessoais quando e onde for permitido pelas leis aplicáveis.


Somente os candidatos pré-selecionados serão contatados para entrevista. Nos empenhamos em responder a todos os candidatos. No entanto, se você não receber uma resposta nossa em até 60 dias, por favor, considere sua candidatura para esta vaga como não aprovada. Podemos entrar em contato futuramente para oportunidades que correspondam às suas qualificações e experiência.


Obrigado por considerar uma carreira na RGE.

title: Node.js Developer | Senior
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Prover soluções técnicas para o desenvolvimento de novas features e dar suporte às features já existentes;
  • Desenvolver e evoluir soluções backend utilizando microserviços e computação serverless, garantindo escalabilidade, alta disponibilidade e resiliência;
  • Desenvolver, manter e evoluir APIs REST e integrações assíncronas com mensagerias;

  • Experiência com Node;

title: Senior Business Analyst (Healthcare Marketing)
description:
One of our clients, a USA Healthcare Commercialization firm, is looking for a Senior Business Analyst with experience in SOWs and Project Finance. This role would be focused on their Speaker Bureau operations (organization of medical conferences and congresses).


The Sr. Business Analyst is responsible for managing financial and operational aspects of assigned clients and their products. This role requires a high level of understanding of the assigned clients and products, various speaker bureau project types, and the ability to work independently.


The Sr. Business Analyst works closely with the Director and financial analysts to ensure accurate internal and external financial reporting, develop budget proposals and provide financial related support in client meetings.


Financial


● Oversee day-to-day financial operations for speaker bureau, including budget tracking, internal revenue accruals, forecasting and variance analysis.

● Develops Statement of Work (SOW), ensuring final sign-off by Director as required.

● Create and manage budgets and proposals, providing oversight for complex SOWs. Prepare speaker bureau specific budgets, accrual reports and monthly financial management updates

● Work closely with program directors on monthly accrual reports, reviewing and discussing as needed.

● Ensure accuracy in financial reconciliation data before releasing reports to clients

● Generate and distribute monthly accruals and budget reports for clients

● Provide invoicing amounts to Accounts Receivable to facilitate timely invoice submissions


Operational


● Ensures compliance with internal Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and client specific SOPs.

● Provides budget related support in client meetings as needed.

● Participates in accrual meetings with clients based on their SOPs.

● Contributes to process improvement initiatives to enhance financial operations.


Experience and Skills


● 2+ Years experience in budgeting · Proficiency in Excel functions for financial modeling and analysis.

● Strong financial analysis skills, including budget tracking, forecasting and variance analysis · Excellent understanding of internal SOPs and ability to ensure compliance

● Familiar with all internal and external SOPs.

● Strives to find process efficiencies by thinking outside the box and making recommendations for change.

● Knowledge of ERP systems, NetSuite a plus

● Excellent client facing skills, including comfortability with all types of client communications.

● Prior speaker bureau experience a plus

title: AI Evaluation Engineer
description:
About FirstIgnite

FirstIgnite is the AI-powered business development platform for university technology transfer offices (TTOs). We help research institutions turn breakthroughs into partnerships, licenses, and companies by combining deep LLM-driven workflows with the relationships that actually move deals forward. Our product suite spans expert discovery, grants search, and AI-driven outreach — all built on a modern, agentic stack.

We ship fast, we measure everything, and we believe evaluations are the difference between AI features that demo well and AI features that work in production.


The Role

We're hiring an AI Evaluation Engineer to own the quality bar for every LLM-powered feature we ship. You'll design, build, and scale the infrastructure that tells us — with evidence — whether a prompt change, model swap, or agent refactor made things better or worse.

This is a high-leverage role. Every customer-facing AI capability at FirstIgnite flows through your evals. You'll work directly with the Head of Engineering and partner closely with product, applied AI, and the full-stack team to establish evaluation as a first-class discipline across the company.


What You'll Do

  • Build evaluation infrastructure: Design and maintain eval suites using Promptfoo, LLM-as-judge methodologies, and custom harnesses for features like our expert search system, natural language grants search, and AI SDR agents.
  • Define what 'good' means: Partner with product and domain experts to translate fuzzy customer outcomes (\"does this surface the right principal investigator?\") into precise, measurable rubrics.
  • Own the feedback loop: Instrument production traffic, curate golden datasets from real customer interactions, and build pipelines that turn user behavior into regression tests.
  • Ship quickly under uncertainty: We routinely run 48-hour eval sprints for greenfield features with no production traffic. You'll be comfortable bootstrapping quality signal from scratch.
  • Model and prompt evaluation: Run rigorous A/B comparisons across models (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight), prompt strategies, and agent architectures. Quantify tradeoffs between cost, latency, and quality.
  • Agent evaluation: Help us measure multi-step agent behavior built on the OpenAI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, and Temporal Cloud — including tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and end-to-end task completion.
  • Raise the floor for the team: Create templates, documentation, and tooling so every engineer can write and run evals as part of normal development. Evals should feel as natural as unit tests.


Requirements

  • 3+ years of engineering experience, with at least 1 year focused on LLM/ML evaluation, applied AI, or data quality systems.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks — Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangSmith, OpenAI Evals, DeepEval, or equivalent in-house tooling.
  • Strong grasp of LLM-as-judge methodology, including its failure modes (position bias, verbosity bias, judge-model drift) and how to mitigate them.
  • Statistical literacy — you know the difference between a real regression and noise, and you can design experiments that answer the question actually being asked.
  • Product instincts. You can sit with a customer success call transcript, identify the three failure modes that matter, and ship an eval for each by end of week.
  • Strong written communication. Evals are useless if the engineers shipping features don't trust or read the results.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience evaluating retrieval systems (RAG, hybrid search, reranking) — especially over structured or semi-structured domains like research, grants, or patents.
  • Exposure to agent orchestration frameworks (Temporal, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK) and the specific challenges of evaluating multi-step, tool-using systems.
  • Background in information retrieval, search relevance, or a research-adjacent domain.
  • Experience building internal tooling or dashboards that non-engineers (PMs, domain experts) actually use to label and review model outputs.


Why This Role

  • You'll be the first dedicated evals hire. The scope, standards, and tooling are yours to define.
  • AI quality is existential for our product. This isn't a compliance role tucked into a corner — it's directly on the critical path to revenue.
  • Small, senior team. ~10 engineers, distributed globally, with a strong bias toward shipping and measuring.
  • Direct access to real-world, high-stakes LLM use cases — research discovery, grants, outbound — across a customer base that deeply values accuracy.


This is a fully remote position. We have engineers across the Americas, Europe, and Africa. Overlap with US working hours is expected.

  • Familiaridade com ambientes técnicos e sistemas de suporte (sistemas de ticketing).

Processo de recrutamento, seleção e integração: Os primeiros contatos serão realizados através de chamada telefónica ou vídeo conferência. title: SAP S/4HANA Finance Consultant
description:
Genesis Consulting has an immediate opportunity for an experienced SAP S/4HANA Finance (FI) Consultant to support a global operation S/4HANA. The consultant will play a critical role in the implementation, configuration, and optimization of core financial processes within SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition. Our clients are some of the world’s leading companies and the candidate will be a part of challenging projects to build and support technical solutions for their needs.



The SAP S/4HANA FI Consultant will act as a functional utility player across the Finance workstream, supporting General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Funds Management, and integration with Procurement, Asset Management, and Payroll. The role requires hands-on participation across all phases of the implementation lifecycle, including design, configuration, testing, cutover, and post-go-live support.



The consultant will work closely with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams to ensure financial processes are aligned to SAP S/4HANA best practices while supporting the client’s operational and regulatory requirements. This includes supporting the transition from ECC-based processes to S/4HANA capabilities, including Fiori-enabled user experiences and embedded analytics.



The FI Consultant will also assist in identifying opportunities to streamline legacy processes, reduce customizations, and leverage standard S/4HANA functionality, while ensuring continuity of critical financial operations during the system conversion.



Duties and Responsibilities:


The Consultant facilitates the implementation and support of SAP S/4HANA Finance solutions to enhance the client’s financial operations and overall system performance, while maintaining a high degree of customer satisfaction.


  • Configure and support SAP S/4HANA Finance components including GL, AP, AR, Asset Accounting
  • Participate in fit-to-standard workshops and support design decisions aligned to S/4HANA best practices
  • Act as a cross-functional contributor, supporting integration points between Finance and modules such as MM (Procurement), EAM (Asset Management), HCM/Payroll, and Project Systems
  • Support the migration and validation of financial data, including balances, open items, and asset data during conversion activities
  • Assist in identifying and supporting remediation of custom code, reports, interfaces, and enhancements impacting Finance processes
  • Support Fiori application enablement, including validation of finance-related apps, roles, and user experience considerations
  • Participate in System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and defect resolution across financial and cross-functional scenarios
  • Collaborate with technical and data teams to support integration, reporting, and data reconciliation activities
  • Support cutover planning and execution, including financial readiness activities and validation of key processes
  • Provide post-go-live support and stabilization assistance for financial operations



Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

  • 3-5 years of SAP experience with a strong focus on Finance (FI) in ECC and S/4HANA environments
  • At least two full lifecycle SAP implementations, including at least one S/4HANA conversion or implementation
  • Hands-on experience with core FI modules including GL, AP, AR, and Asset Accounting
  • Functional integration experience with SAP modules including MM, EAM, HCM/Payroll, and Project Systems
  • Experience supporting financial data migration, reconciliation, and validation activities
  • Experience with SAP Fiori applications and understanding of role-based access and user experience
  • Experience supporting testing cycles including SIT and UAT in integrated SAP environments
  • Working knowledge of custom code impacts (reports, interfaces, enhancements) and ability to support functional validation
  • Experience with SAP reporting and analytics, including embedded analytics or BW-based reporting
  • Strong understanding of financial close processes, including month-end and year-end activities
  • Experience working in Agile or SAP Activate-based delivery models


Minimum Education:


  • Bachelor’s Degree – Preferred
  • Bachelor of Science or Computer Science, Information Systems, Electrical/Computer Engineering or equivalent experience preferred or Accounting (preferred).



Required Certifications:


  • Certification in S/4 HANA, and/or other SAP Solutions is a plus.



Other:


  • Experience working in distributed delivery environments, including coordination with offshore or nearshore teams (e.g., LATAM delivery centers)
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work directly with business stakeholders
  • Ability to support a hybrid delivery model with remote and on-site collaboration as required

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule

Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.

Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

ESTAMOS CONTRATANDO DESENVOLVEDOR PHP/LARAVEL SÊNIOR


Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Sênior PHP com forte experiência em Laravel para atuar na evolução de uma plataforma educacional de grande escala, com mais de 150 mil usuários ativos.


Nosso ecossistema é baseado em uma arquitetura híbrida, combinando aplicações backend em PHP/Laravel com WordPress estruturado via Bedrock e Roots Acorn, além de integrações com BuddyBoss e LearnDash.

  • Experiência com versionamento utilizando Git;

O que é um diferencial:

title: Marketing AI Agent Builder
description:
Role Overview:

As our Marketing AI Agent Builder, you will be the lead architect for our \"agentic\" marketing stack. Your goal is to move beyond simple automation (if-this-then-that) toward autonomous systems that reason through marketing data, execute multi-channel campaigns, and self-correct based on performance. This is a \"Builder\" role—part Engineer, part Strategist, part Data Scientist. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA.

Core Responsibilities:

• Intelligent Research & Segmentation: Deploy agents to crawl the web for intent signals (hiring changes, funding, news) to dynamically update ICP segments and enrich CRM records in real-time.

• Autonomous Campaign Management: Build agents that independently monitor live campaigns (Search, Social, Email) and autonomously reallocate budgets or pause underperforming creatives based on real-time ROI.

• Dynamic Lead Nurturing: Design agents that use Natural Language Processing (NLP) to \"read\" prospect behavior and trigger personalized, multi-step nurture sequences without manual intervention.

• Performance & Guardrails: Establish \"human-in-the-loop\" protocols and evaluation frameworks to ensure agent outputs align with brand voice and security standards.

• System Orchestration: Connect AI agents to our core stack—including HubSpot/Salesforce, 6sense, and Google Analytics—ensuring seamless data flow and automated write-backs to the CRM.

Qualifications & Skills:

• Experience: 2–4 years in Growth Engineering, ideally with experience scaling a mid-market SaaS revenue engine.

• AI Tooling: Proficiency with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI) or low-code builder platforms (e.g., Claude CoWork, CodeX)

• Agent Orchestration: Experience with low-code/no-code platforms (e.g., Clay, Zapier Central, Make.com) or code-based frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI).

• Prompt Engineering: Ability to design complex \"reasoning loops\" that prevent hallucinations and ensure professional, brand-aligned output.

• Data Savvy: Comfortable working with JSON, APIs, and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) to feed agents the right context from your company’s internal knowledge base.

• Marketing Expertise: Knowledge of B2B buyer journeys, attribution models, and demand generation tactics.

title: SAP S/4HANA Finance Consultant
description:
Genesis Consulting has an immediate opportunity for an experienced SAP S/4HANA Finance (FI) Consultant to support a global operation S/4HANA. The consultant will play a critical role in the implementation, configuration, and optimization of core financial processes within SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition. Our clients are some of the world’s leading companies and the candidate will be a part of challenging projects to build and support technical solutions for their needs.



The SAP S/4HANA FI Consultant will act as a functional utility player across the Finance workstream, supporting General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Funds Management, and integration with Procurement, Asset Management, and Payroll. The role requires hands-on participation across all phases of the implementation lifecycle, including design, configuration, testing, cutover, and post-go-live support.



The consultant will work closely with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams to ensure financial processes are aligned to SAP S/4HANA best practices while supporting the client’s operational and regulatory requirements. This includes supporting the transition from ECC-based processes to S/4HANA capabilities, including Fiori-enabled user experiences and embedded analytics.



The FI Consultant will also assist in identifying opportunities to streamline legacy processes, reduce customizations, and leverage standard S/4HANA functionality, while ensuring continuity of critical financial operations during the system conversion.



Duties and Responsibilities:


The Consultant facilitates the implementation and support of SAP S/4HANA Finance solutions to enhance the client’s financial operations and overall system performance, while maintaining a high degree of customer satisfaction.


  • Configure and support SAP S/4HANA Finance components including GL, AP, AR, Asset Accounting
  • Participate in fit-to-standard workshops and support design decisions aligned to S/4HANA best practices
  • Act as a cross-functional contributor, supporting integration points between Finance and modules such as MM (Procurement), EAM (Asset Management), HCM/Payroll, and Project Systems
  • Support the migration and validation of financial data, including balances, open items, and asset data during conversion activities
  • Assist in identifying and supporting remediation of custom code, reports, interfaces, and enhancements impacting Finance processes
  • Support Fiori application enablement, including validation of finance-related apps, roles, and user experience considerations
  • Participate in System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and defect resolution across financial and cross-functional scenarios
  • Collaborate with technical and data teams to support integration, reporting, and data reconciliation activities
  • Support cutover planning and execution, including financial readiness activities and validation of key processes
  • Provide post-go-live support and stabilization assistance for financial operations



Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

  • 3-5 years of SAP experience with a strong focus on Finance (FI) in ECC and S/4HANA environments
  • At least two full lifecycle SAP implementations, including at least one S/4HANA conversion or implementation
  • Hands-on experience with core FI modules including GL, AP, AR, and Asset Accounting
  • Functional integration experience with SAP modules including MM, EAM, HCM/Payroll, and Project Systems
  • Experience supporting financial data migration, reconciliation, and validation activities
  • Experience with SAP Fiori applications and understanding of role-based access and user experience
  • Experience supporting testing cycles including SIT and UAT in integrated SAP environments
  • Working knowledge of custom code impacts (reports, interfaces, enhancements) and ability to support functional validation
  • Experience with SAP reporting and analytics, including embedded analytics or BW-based reporting
  • Strong understanding of financial close processes, including month-end and year-end activities
  • Experience working in Agile or SAP Activate-based delivery models


Minimum Education:


  • Bachelor’s Degree – Preferred
  • Bachelor of Science or Computer Science, Information Systems, Electrical/Computer Engineering or equivalent experience preferred or Accounting (preferred).



Required Certifications:


  • Certification in S/4 HANA, and/or other SAP Solutions is a plus.



Other:


  • Experience working in distributed delivery environments, including coordination with offshore or nearshore teams (e.g., LATAM delivery centers)
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work directly with business stakeholders
  • Ability to support a hybrid delivery model with remote and on-site collaboration as required

title: Business Intelligence Analyst
description:
About the Company


Fraud Deflect helps businesses make better decisions around fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance. We work with high-volume operational data and need clear, trusted reporting that helps teams move quickly and make better decisions.



About the Role


We are looking for a BI Analyst to own and improve business reporting across fraud, chargebacks, alerts, merchant performance, and operations. This role is focused on dashboards, KPI tracking, reporting consistency, metric definitions, and turning business questions into clear, actionable insights.

You will work closely with leadership, operations, product, and engineering to make data easier to understand, easier to trust, and more useful in day-to-day decision-making.


Responsibilities

  • Write and optimize SQL for reporting, analysis, and data validation
  • Define, document, and improve business metrics so teams are working from consistent numbers
  • Analyze trends, anomalies, and performance changes across key datasets
  • Partner with stakeholders to translate business questions into practical reporting and analysis
  • Improve the usability, accuracy, and trustworthiness of existing reports and dashboards
  • Identify reporting gaps, data inconsistencies, and metric definition issues
  • Create clear visualizations and present findings in a business-friendly way
  • Support self-service reporting and help teams use data more effectively


Requirements

  • Strong SQL skills
  • Experience building and maintaining dashboards and recurring business reporting
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to translate ambiguous business questions into clear metrics, reporting, and analysis
  • Experience working with production data and validating reporting accuracy
  • Strong communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience defining and maintaining KPIs or business metrics
  • Comfortable working in a remote environment
  • Able to pass a background check


Preferred

  • Experience with fraud, payments, chargebacks, disputes, risk, or other operational data
  • Experience with BI and visualization tools
  • Experience working with large datasets in a business reporting environment
  • Experience with AWS-based data environments
  • Basic Python skills for ad hoc analysis or validation
  • Experience with ClickHouse or similar analytical databases
  • Familiarity with data warehouse or reporting-layer concepts


How to Apply

title: Engenheiro de Dados Especialista
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls , em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

  • Garantir a qualidade, integridade e confiabilidade dos dados, estabelecendo processos de monitoramento e validação;
  • Atuar como ponte entre a tecnologia e as áreas de negócio, garantindo que as soluções de dados estejam alinhadas aos objetivos estratégicos da empresa.


Requisitos:


  • Formação em Tecnologia.

  • Vivência em liderança de equipes e metodologias ágeis;

title: DevOps Engineer SR
description:
DevOps Engineer SR


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


This is a highly sensitive and mission‑critical role with admin‑level access to the core platform. The ideal professional is exceptionally reliable, security‑minded, technically strong, and trustworthy, ensuring the stability, performance, and resilience of cloud infrastructure supporting large‑scale production systems.

You will lead cloud operations, infrastructure automation, observability, and performance optimization across AWS environments, ensuring secure, cost‑efficient, and scalable solutions.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Manage and optimize AWS infrastructure including ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;
  • Design, deploy, and maintain Infrastructure as Code using AWS CloudFormation;
  • Own and enhance CI/CD pipelines using CircleCI or similar tools, including automated deployments, rollback strategies, and environment versioning;
  • Implement and maintain observability frameworks leveraging tools such as New Relic and Splunk for monitoring, logging, alerting, and incident response;
  • Diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks across databases, services, network layers, and workloads;
  • Lead AWS cost‑optimization initiatives, ensuring performance and reliability remain uncompromised;
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional engineering, architecture, and operations teams to support deployments, troubleshoot issues, and evolve platform capabilities;
  • Ensure best‑in‑class security practices for sensitive production environments, including IAM hardening and compliance with internal controls.


Essential Skills


  • Expertise with ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;
  • Strong experience with CloudFormation for managing AWS infrastructure;
  • Hands-on experience with CircleCI or similar tools, including deployment automation and rollback strategies;
  • Proficiency with monitoring and logging tools like New Relic, and Splunk;
  • Ability to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks in database queries, configurations, and infrastructure;
  • Experience reducing AWS costs while maintaining or improving system reliability and performans.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Hands-on experience operating Amazon Aurora MySQL/Postgres in production environments, including version upgrade procedures, performance tuning, and troubleshooting;
  • Strong understanding of Aurora architecture, read replicas, automated backups, point-in-time recovery, failover mechanisms, and high availability patterns;
  • Proven track record performing database version upgrades in production with minimal downtime, including compatibility testing, replication management, and performance validation.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Product Designer Lead (UX/UI)
description:
⚠️ Professional English is a requirement for this role⚠️

⚠️ A challenge will be required for evaluation ⚠️


About Foundey


Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • 6+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Java especialista #1002116

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


O que você precisa ter?

Desenvolvedor Back-End Especialista. Buscamos alguém com boa experiência em Java, confortável em atuar com microsserviços e desafios técnicos do dia a dia. Valorizamos um perfil autônomo, que gosta de resolver problemas com iniciativa e responsabilidade.

  • Azure ServiceBus / RabbitMQ
  • Oracle / MongoDB

  • Testes com JUnit 4 e 5 (Jupiter)

  • Conhecimentos sólidos em port and adapters e coreografia de eventos
  • Vivência em ambiente ágil
  • Perfil comprometido, questionador, curioso, detalhista, hands-on
  • Diferencial: Node.js.


O que você fará no seu dia a dia?

  • Liderança técnica e desenvolvimento em arquitetura de microsserviços com Java e Spring
  • Integração com mensagerias, bancos relacionais e não relacionais
  • Aplicação de boas práticas de testes e automações
  • Criação de soluções escaláveis, seguras e resilientes

title: Server Manager (Global Project)
description:
Sobre a Vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional altamente qualificado(a) para integrar nossa equipe de Enhanced Operation Service (EOS), que faz parte da organização de Enterprise Cloud Services Delivery. Nesta função, você atuará como um consultor de confiança, sendo responsável por salvaguardar e otimizar a entrega de ponta a ponta para clientes estratégicos durante sua jornada de transformação em nuvem.


Responsabilidades

  • Gestão de Incidentes e Problemas: Participar ativamente no tratamento de incidentes críticos, solucionar falhas em solicitações de serviço e realizar análise de causa raiz para interrupções ou problemas de desempenho.
  • Solicitações de Serviço e Mudança: Executar solicitações de serviço e mudanças complexas, gerenciando extensões de tempo de inatividade e incidentes de longa duração.
  • Otimização de Performance: Identificar e liderar iniciativas proativas para melhorar a operação, estabilidade e padronização dos sistemas dos clientes.
  • Suporte Técnico Especializado: Fornecer suporte técnico especializado em Linux e infraestrutura, com foco em solução de problemas de disco, servidor e conectividade de rede.
  • Melhoria Contínua: Otimizar procedimentos operacionais padrão por meio de automação e definir planos de ação corretiva para atingir os KPIs estabelecidos.
  • Orquestração e Colaboração: Coordenar o trabalho entre diversas unidades de serviços de nuvem, internos e externos, garantindo uma entrega contínua.


Requisitos

  • Expertise em Linux: Sólida experiência prática em administração de SUSE, Red Hat ou Ubuntu. É essencial ter vivência real em troubleshooting de performance, disco e sistema.
  • Clustering & HA: Experiência de 2 a 3 anos em configurações de Alta Disponibilidade (HA). Conhecimento em Pacemaker é preferencial.
  • Proficiencia em Nuvem: Experiência prática em pelo menos um dos principais provedores de nuvem pública: AWS, Azure ou GCP.
  • Redes: Capacidade avançada para diagnosticar problemas de rede em ambiente Linux e nuvem, incluindo TCP/IP, DNS, LDAP, NAT, firewalls e análise de conectividade.
  • Automação: Experiência com linguagens de script (Shell, Python, Go, etc.) e ferramentas de automação de servidores como Ansible ou CHEF.
  • Experiência Profissional: Mínimo 8 a 10 anos de experiência na área de infraestrutura de TI e operações de servidores.
  • Formação Acadêmica: Graduação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Gestão de TI ou áreas correlatas.
  • Idioma: Inglês Fluente é imprescindível.


Quem Somos

Talento onde você precisa, quando você precisa!
